document.abstract: With a membership of more than 10,500 global film industry artists and leaders, an acclaimed film museum and collection, and world-renowned awards, the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences is the world’s preeminent movie-related organization. The Academy recognizes and celebrates all aspects of the film industry and the people who make motion pictures; connects global audiences through their shared passion for the movies; and leads honest and relevant initiatives about cinema’s past, present, and future.

authors.bio: George Joblove is the vice president of Technology and Standards of the Science and Technology Council of the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences, Beverly Hills, CA. He is a SMPTE Fellow and an associate member of the American Society of Cinematographers.
authors.name: George Joblove

authors.bio: Alex Forsythe is the director of Imaging Technology for the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences, Beverly Hills, CA. He is the author of numerous SMPTE standards and serves on the US Technical Advisory Group to ISO TC 36.
authors.name: Alex Forsythe

authors.bio: Cesario Tio is a senior manager, Sci-Tech History, Forums, and Awards for the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences, Beverly Hills, CA. He applies his background in software development and project management to advancing the Council’s mission to foster cooperation for technological progress.
authors.name: Cesario Tio
